en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the left foreground stands a prominent church with a tall square tower topped by an onion‑shaped dome and cross. Clustered around it are steep‑roofed houses and low masonry buildings. In the mid‑distance a large, lighter‑colored institutional building (likely a school or town hall) sits beside a winding country road that leads into open fields and wooded hills. On the right, a grassy slope with a simple wooden fence and a few trees descends toward the town, framing the scene.
